title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Jackson Suber leads RBC Canadian Open
items.text: Jackson Suber leads the 2026 RBC Canadian Open with a score of 13-under (197) after a shooting a 66 at TPC Toronto’s North Course on Saturday

items.headline: Brooks Koepka injury scare
items.text: Brooks Koepka faced an injury scare during the $9.8M event at the RBC Canadian Open just a week before the U.S. Open, but showed signs of returning to form after prior adjustments.

items.headline: Alex Fitzpatrick on Tour pressures
items.text: Alex Fitzpatrick reflected on the pressure felt after instantly earning his PGA Tour card but is now confident following strong finishes including a Zurich Classic win and top-10s in Miami and the Memorial.
